## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
How should this feature work?

## Workflow Impact
Which workflows will be affected?

- [ ] Content Pipeline (WF1-WF5)
- [ ] Image Pipeline (WF6-WF6.5)
- [ ] Social Media Pipeline (WF7)
- [ ] Newsletter Pipeline (WF8)
- [ ] New Workflow Required

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions you've considered.

## Implementation Notes
Technical details or constraints to consider.

## Priority
- [ ] Critical - System broken without this
- [ ] High - Significantly improves workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Future consideration
